one_line: The same one-word comment CTA spoken, boxed and in the caption, after a deadline offer on a held-up book.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 she stands in a garden facing the lens, a hardcover held in front of her. Said (transcript): "לכבוד יום הולדת 38, אני החלטתי לתת את הספר שלי". Subtitle "לכבוד יום הולדת" from 0:00, a flower-crown filter from 0:01.
q1_hook.why: A face speaking to the lens, book in hand from frame zero (H4, S1), the first words also on screen (T3, H6). "To give my book" hints at an offer, but the discount lands only at 0:05 (H2), and a birthday greeting is a slower reason to stay than a problem or result (H1).

beats.what: Book held to the lens, flower crown from 0:01; "לכבוד יום הולדת 38, אני החלטתי לתת"
beats.why: Birthday framing and the book in frame together.

beats.what: Bunting, then a "38% הנחה" badge; "לכל ילדי ישראל ב-38 % הנחה"
beats.why: The offer lands, backed by a sticker.

beats.what: Badge "משלוח חינם עד 16.10"; "זה מחיר שלא היה ולא יהיה"
beats.why: Adds free shipping and a deadline.

beats.what: Balloons marked 38; "ואני מאוד מתרגשת שהוא הולך להגיע לעוד אלפי ילדים"
beats.why: A warm personal line, no new fact.

beats.what: "הביטחון העצמי שלהם... לקרוא אותו לפני השינה וליהנות מכל רגע"
beats.why: The only product benefit, over unchanged framing.

beats.what: She points down; "לפרטים, כתבו לי ספר." Top box: "כתבי לי בתגובות"
beats.why: One ask, said and shown, right at the end.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Said at about 0:21 and boxed at 0:22: write "ספר" in the comments for the details. The caption repeats it. No question, no send or save ask.
q2_flow.why: One take with one person talking, so stickers and subtitle highlights set the pace, a new one every 3 to 4 s (R3, E1). The offer and deadline arrive by 0:11, but the single benefit line is at 0:14 to 0:20 over unchanged framing (R3). It ends on the CTA with no tail (R1, R4).

q3_cta.what: Spoken (transcript, about 0:21): "לפרטים כתבו לי ספר", subtitled "לפרטים," and "כתבו לי ספר." (0:22). Top box from 0:22: "אם תרצי לקבל את כל הפרטים על הספר, כתבי לי בתגובות \"ספר\"". Caption's last line: the same, for the link.
q3_cta.why: One action in voice, on screen and in the caption (C1, C6), after the offer and benefit, with a deadline and a clear reward, the link and discount (C3, C2). The box sits in the top 14% and the caption states the ask only in its last line (C6, F2).

q4_shown.what: The hardcover held to the lens throughout (a boy in a cape and a woman whispering, title readable). Her face. Stickers: a "38% הנחה" badge, a "משלוח חינם עד 16.10" badge, balloons marked 38, bunting, a flower crown. No inside page, child or shekel price.
q4_shown.why: The cover is on screen from frame zero (S1) and the offer appears in words, badge and caption, but as a percentage and free shipping, not a full shekel price (S3). With no page, child or likeness proof, the book itself is not shown (S2, S8). The author talks about her own book (S6).

q5_edit.what: One take of 24 s, no cuts, handheld. The book is raised, tilted and lowered every 2 s or so. Stickers pop in at 0:01, 0:04, 0:06, 0:08 and 0:11, subtitles with a pink highlighted word change every 1 to 2 s. CTA box 0:22.
q5_edit.why: With no cuts, stickers and subtitle highlights do the pacing (E2, R3). Subtitles timed to the voice let it work muted (E4, T1). The crown, bunting, badges and balloons compete with her face and the book (T2). It stops right after the ask (E8).

q6_topic.what: A 38th-birthday sale on her own children's book (38% off, free shipping to 16.10), with one line on self-confidence and bedtime reading. Serves a parent open to a deal.
q6_topic.why: A deadline sale framed as a birthday is a reason to act now, but the occasion is hers, not the buyer's (K7). The benefit line is modest and tied to a bedtime routine parents know (K6, K4). Her excitement is the only emotion, with no peak moment (K1).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld selfie-style medium shot at eye level in a garden with lawn and trees, daylight. She stands, talks to the lens and moves the book in and out of frame. A filter and app stickers are added. No child.
q7_filmed.why: Direct address, daylight and a real garden give a native creator look (F6, H8, F7). The book is tilted and sometimes cut by her hand, so the cover is not always readable (F4). The CTA box sits in the top 14% (F2).

q8_text.on_screen: Burned-in subtitles of the whole speech, bold white with one pink highlighted word, about 60% down, 2 to 4 words at a time: "לכבוד יום הולדת" (0:00), "ב-38 % הנחה," (0:05), "זה מחיר שלא" (0:08), "הביטחון העצמי שלהם" (0:15). Badges "38% הנחה" (0:06), "משלוח חינם עד 16.10" (0:08). Top CTA box at 0:22.
q8_text.caption: "יום הולדת 38 לחן, ומתנה לכל הילדים." Five short lines: birthday, 38% off with free shipping, the deadline "מבצע ליומיים בלבד", the comment-word ask, four hashtags. No disclosure (her own book).
q8_text.why: Short, large, synced subtitles work muted (T1, T5), but a highlighted word plus stickers fill a busy frame (T2). The CTA box is in the top 14% (T4, F2). The caption opens with the occasion, names the offer and deadline and has four specific hashtags (T7).

weak_points: The book is never opened, no child or reaction; the hook is a birthday greeting before the offer; busy stickers and a filter; the CTA box in the top 14%; no shekel price; "כתבי" in the box, "כתבו" in speech.
lumebook_takeaway: Talk to the lens, book held up, state the offer and deadline by 0:08, and repeat one comment word in voice, a box and the caption.
not_verified: That she is the author (the transcript says "הספר שלי"); the shekel price; whether a comment really gets a link; the music (none evident). Additions to the first pass: sticker times (38% badge 0:06, shipping badge 0:08, balloons from 0:11, bunting from 0:04), subtitles at about 60% down, and the top-14% CTA box. The book's title contains the character's name, not quoted here. Plays 1,135, likes 10 on 15 Oct are context only.
